name: Catheter Tipping
description: Forming the distal ends of thermoplastic catheters to achieve smooth, atraumatic tips for device insertion. Commonly performed using ONEX Catheter Tipper systems with custom die and mandrel tooling.

sub_applications.name: Dilator Tip Forming
sub_applications.description: Forming rounded or tapered dilator tips that ease entry into vessels or sheaths. Demonstrates smooth geometry and wall-thickness uniformity across Pebax and Polyimide materials.

sub_applications.name: Sheath Tip Forming
sub_applications.description: Used to produce distal sheath tips with gradual tapers for atraumatic insertion and controlled stiffness transition. Typically formed in Polyethylene or Polyurethane.

sub_applications.name: Bullet Nose Tip Forming
sub_applications.description: Forms the characteristic rounded 'bullet-nose' tip for atraumatic device insertion. Commonly used in Pebax or Polyimide catheters to achieve low-profile entry geometry.

sub_applications.name: Taper / Conical Tip
sub_applications.description: A gradual conical taper formed at the catheter’s distal end to aid smooth insertion and reduce trauma. Achieved using precision dies and mandrels to maintain consistent wall thickness.

sub_applications.name: Closed End Tip
sub_applications.description: Forms a sealed distal tip for catheters or tubing requiring a fluid-tight termination. Used in diagnostic or balloon catheters where a guidewire lumen ends distally.

sub_applications.name: Neckdown
sub_applications.description: Reduces tube diameter to create a transition zone between two different lumen sizes or to attach components. Often applied before bonding or overmolding operations.

sub_applications.name: Tip and End Forming
sub_applications.description: General category covering the shaping, rounding, or flaring of catheter ends for clinical performance and safety. Applied to distal or proximal ends depending on function.

sub_applications.name: Radius Tip
sub_applications.description: Creates a rounded distal end with a controlled radius for atraumatic entry into vessels. Often used in dilator and introducer designs.

sub_applications.name: Angle Tip
sub_applications.description: Forms an angled or beveled distal end to aid navigation and selective access within anatomy. Used in angiographic and diagnostic catheters.

sub_applications.name: Multi-Lumen Tip
sub_applications.description: Used for catheters with multiple lumens requiring uniform tip geometry and lumen alignment. Ensures consistent flow and bonding between lumens.

sub_applications.name: Soft Tip
sub_applications.description: Applies a softer polymer at the distal end for improved patient comfort and reduced vessel trauma. Typically bonded or formed over a stiffer shaft.

sub_applications.name: IV Tip
sub_applications.description: Forms the distal geometry of intravenous catheters and cannulas for smooth venous entry. Focuses on minimizing insertion resistance and tip burrs.

sub_applications.name: Guidewire Tip
sub_applications.description: Creates small, highly precise distal ends for guidewire covers or tubing. Designed for exceptional concentricity and flexibility at micro-scale diameters.

sub_applications.name: CVC Tip
sub_applications.description: Used for forming distal tips of central venous catheters (CVCs), offering smooth entry and biocompatibility for long-term vascular access.
sub_applications.long_description: Central Venous Catheter (CVC) tips demand highly controlled geometries, strong and uniform distal bonds, and a tightly repeatable thermal-forming process to ensure safe, reliable clinical performance. Variations in tubing sizes, multi-lumen constructions, polymer blends, and tip profiles make CVC tip forming a complex manufacturing challenge that requires deep process understanding. ONEX specializes in supporting customers through this exact application, providing the expertise, purpose-built catheter tipping machines, precision-engineered tooling, and hands-on process development needed to achieve consistent, production-ready results.

sub_applications.name: Urinary Tip
sub_applications.description: Forms the smooth distal tips of urinary or Foley catheters for atraumatic urethral insertion and patient comfort.

sub_applications.name: Angiographic Tip
sub_applications.description: Used in shaping distal ends of angiographic catheters with precise geometries to ensure optimal flow dynamics and navigation in vessels.

sub_applications.name: Tracheal Tip
sub_applications.description: Forms smooth distal ends of tracheal and endotracheal tubes to minimize airway irritation. Often features rounded and radiused edges.

sub_applications.name: PEEK Tube Forming
sub_applications.description: Thermoforming of high-performance PEEK tubing for structural medical applications requiring rigidity, chemical resistance, and precision geometry.

sub_applications.name: PEEK Mushroom Forming
sub_applications.description: Creates mushroom-shaped ends on PEEK tubing for secure mechanical retention or component interfacing. Used in high-strength catheter or connector assemblies.

sub_applications.name: Micro Catheter Tipping
sub_applications.description: Enables formation of ultra-small tips for neurovascular or micro-delivery catheters. Ensures tight concentricity and delicate material control at sub-millimeter scales.

sub_applications.name: Balloon Catheter Tip
sub_applications.description: Forms or bonds distal tips on balloon catheters, ensuring strong adhesion and smooth transitions between balloon and shaft segments.

sub_applications.name: Urethral Access Sheath
sub_applications.description: Shapes and flares distal ends of urethral access sheaths to ease instrument passage and reduce patient discomfort during urological procedures.

sub_applications.name: Diameter Reduction
sub_applications.description: Uniformly decreases catheter or tubing diameter to achieve tighter fits, bonding zones, or specialized transitions for multi-section assemblies.

sub_applications.name: Variable Catheter Lumen Diameter
sub_applications.description: Produces catheters with varying internal lumen diameters along their length for tailored flow dynamics or mechanical properties.

name: Catheter Flaring
description: Expanding proximal catheter ends for hub or connector attachment. This process produces conical or hood-style geometries for assembly and fluid-tight connection.

sub_applications.name: Flared Conical Shape
sub_applications.description: Creates a smooth, conical flare at the proximal end to mate with connectors or hubs. Provides mechanical strength and leak-proof assembly during bonding.
sub_applications.long_description: Long description for Flared Conical Shape

sub_applications.name: Hood-Formed Tip
sub_applications.description: Produces a proximal hood or bell-mouth geometry used for catheter-hub transitions or fluid port integration.

sub_applications.name: Introducer Tip Forming
sub_applications.description: Creates the tapered leading edge of introducer catheters and sheaths. Designed for consistent OD reduction and concentricity using custom die-mandrel sets.
